basic_details.job_title: GSVM Medical College Recruitment 2026 – Walk-in for 133 Professor, Associate Professor & Other Posts
basic_details.short_information: The walk-in interview is on 27 November 2026, between 10:00 AM and 04:00 PM, at Examination Hall-3, Medical College, Kanpur; the Office of the Principal, G.S.V.M. Medical College, Kanpur (जी0एस0वी0एम0 मेडिकल कालेज, कानपुर) says candidates may appear on every Friday of the month after the notice is issued. The college is filling 133 contract posts – 13 Professor (आचार्य), 42 Associate Professor (सह आचार्य) and 78 Assistant Professor (सहायक आचार्य) – in its departments and Trauma Centre, with fixed pay of Rs. 2,20,000/-, Rs. 1,60,000/- and Rs. 1,20,000/- respectively.

important_instructions: The contract term is one year. After one year of satisfactory service, it may be extended as needed if no candidate selected through the Public Service Commission or regular teacher is available. Services end immediately when teachers selected by direct recruitment through the Public Service Commission become available; services may also be ended with one month's notice if found unsatisfactory. Either party may end the contract at any time with one month's notice or one month's contract pay. Appointed teachers must join the medical college within 30 days of the agreement; otherwise the contract will be treated as cancelled. No other pay, allowance or service benefit is admissible beyond the fixed pay; no pension benefit and no bonus is payable for the contract period. Contract teachers are not entitled to regularisation in government service, and the agreement will state that they will not claim regularisation or permanency. Other service conditions will be as specified in the agreement or contract letter.

No private practice on OPD days. Teachers doing private practice must specify the place of their private practice. No medical teacher will compel patients coming to the college's attached hospitals to be seen privately. Teachers doing private practice must always be available for emergency and disaster services in the medical college.
The number of super speciality posts may decrease or increase if posts are adjusted. Vacancies and terms of appointment are available on the college website www.gsvmmedicalcollege.com.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: Reservation applies to these posts as per rules, and the number of posts may decrease or increase. The notice also gives the fixed pay for the post of Lecturer, Pharmacy as Rs. 75000/- per month, but the Pharmacy row of the vacancy table shows no vacancy. The notice lists no vacancy in Ophthalmology, Transfusion Medicine, ENT, Critical Care (PMSSY), Dental, Neurosurgery, Neuro Ophthalmology, Neuro Radiology (PMSSY), Nephrology (Medicine), Pathology, Physical & Medical Rehabilitation (PMSSY), Pharmacy, Microbiology, Medical Gastroenterology and Urology (PMSSY). The category and roster number of each post (UR, OBC, SC, ST, EWS) is printed against it in the official notice. Candidates must meet the educational qualifications and experience prescribed by the Medical Council of India, Minimum Qualification For Teachers in Medical Institutions Regulations, 2022. The qualification and experience of medical teachers will follow the U.P. State Medical College Teachers Service Rules (Fifth Amendment)-2018 and the service rules issued earlier from time to time. The qualification for super speciality posts will be as per the latest NMC guidelines. As per NMC guidelines, Senior Residency is required for Assistant Professor and an MET/BCBR certificate for Professor and Associate Professor. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post. Candidates who passed from the college concerned and new postgraduate degree holders will get preference over earlier candidates. A candidate who holds any other qualification in addition to MD/MS will be given preference. The maximum age, counted on the first day of July of the year of appointment, is: For retired medical teachers appointed on contract in government allopathic medical colleges, the maximum age limit is 70 years (Government Order dated 23-09-2013). To get the benefit of EWS reservation, the total annual income must be less than Rs. 8.00 lakh, and the family income and asset certificate must be issued or certified by the Tehsildar of the area or a higher officer.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: All original certificates. One set of self-attested photocopies of all educational and experience certificates and research papers. Senior Residency certificate for Assistant Professor, as per NMC guidelines. MET/BCBR certificate for Professor and Associate Professor, as per NMC guidelines. Biodata.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Selection is made through a walk-in interview by a selection committee appointed by the Government. At the time of the interview, each candidate must also give a declaration that no criminal case is pending against them in any court; if any adverse fact is found later, the services will be terminated.

faq.question: Q1. When is the GSVM Medical College walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 27 November 2026, and the notice says candidates may appear on every Friday of the month after the notice is issued.

faq.question: Q2. What is the time and venue of the walk-in?
faq.answer: Candidates must appear between 10:00 AM and 04:00 PM at Examination Hall-3, Medical College, Kanpur.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are 133 contract posts: 13 Professor, 42 Associate Professor and 78 Assistant Professor.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: Candidates must meet the qualifications and experience of the Medical Council of India, Minimum Qualification For Teachers in Medical Institutions Regulations, 2022, with Senior Residency for Assistant Professor and an MET/BCBR certificate for Professor and Associate Professor as per NMC guidelines.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age on 1 July of the year of appointment is 60 years for Assistant Professor, 64 years for Associate Professor and 68 years for Professor; retired medical teachers may be appointed up to 70 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The fixed pay is Rs. 2,20,000/- for Professor, Rs. 1,60,000/- for Associate Professor and Rs. 1,20,000/- for Assistant Professor, with no other pay, allowance or service benefit admissible.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I bring?
faq.answer: Bring all original certificates, one set of self-attested photocopies of educational and experience certificates and research papers, the Senior Residency or MET/BCBR certificate as applicable, and a biodata.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is through a walk-in interview by a selection committee appointed by the Government.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is on contract for one year, may be extended on satisfactory service, and gives no claim to regularisation or permanency.

faq.question: Q10. Who gets preference in selection?
faq.answer: Candidates who passed from the college concerned and new postgraduate degree holders get preference over earlier candidates, and so do candidates holding another qualification in addition to MD/MS.
